ex.en: This laboratory is equipped with the latest computers.
ex.zh: 這間實驗室配備了最新的電腦。

ex.en: This laboratory is where we work every day.
ex.zh: 這間實驗室是我們每天工作的地方。

ex.en: A series of blasts reduced the laboratory to ruins.
ex.zh: 一連串的爆炸把實驗室炸成了廢墟。

laboratory.en: a room with special equipment for scientific work

ex.en: Mary keeps her laptop with her at all times.
ex.zh: 瑪麗總是把筆記型電腦帶在身上。

ex.en: Tom sat on his bed and opened his laptop.
ex.zh: 湯姆坐在床上，打開了筆記型電腦。

ex.en: The laptop provides cutting-edge technology at an affordable price.
ex.zh: 這台筆電以平實的價格提供最新的技術。

laptop.en: a small computer that you can carry and use on your knees

ex.en: The air conditioner in the lab is broken.
ex.zh: 實驗室的冷氣壞了。

ex.en: The samples were sent to the lab for testing.
ex.zh: 樣本已經送到實驗室檢測。

ex.en: She works in a computer lab at the university.
ex.zh: 她在大學的電腦教室工作。

lab.en: a room with special equipment for scientific work

ex.en: I'd like to turn off the reading lamp, is that OK?
ex.zh: 我想把閱讀燈關掉，可以嗎？

ex.en: He hung a lamp from the ceiling.
ex.zh: 他把一盞燈掛在天花板上。

ex.en: Are you selling these lamps?
ex.zh: 這些燈有在賣嗎？

lamp.en: a device that gives light, often standing on a table

ex.en: I've had a lot of work to do lately.
ex.zh: 我最近有很多工作要做。

ex.en: I have been under a lot of pressure lately.
ex.zh: 我最近壓力很大。

ex.en: Speaking of Mr. Tanaka, have you seen him lately?
ex.zh: 說到田中先生，你最近有見到他嗎？

ex.en: He lost his balance and fell off the ladder.
ex.zh: 他失去了平衡，從梯子上摔了下來。

ex.en: Stand the ladder against the wall.
ex.zh: 把梯子靠在牆上。

ex.en: Is this ladder strong enough to bear my weight?
ex.zh: 這把梯子夠堅固，撐得住我的重量嗎？

ladder.en: a tool with steps for climbing up to high places

ex.en: She climbed the corporate ladder quickly.
ex.zh: 她在公司裡升遷得很快。

ex.en: He started at the bottom of the career ladder.
ex.zh: 他從職涯的最基層做起。

ladder.en: a series of levels through which a person can move up in a job or group

ex.en: Get into the left lane to make room for the guy who's trying to merge.
ex.zh: 切到左邊車道，讓要併入的那台車有空間。

ex.en: Are there any bike lanes in Algiers?
ex.zh: 阿爾及爾有腳踏車道嗎？

ex.en: This lane is for buses only.
ex.zh: 這條車道是公車專用道。

lane.en: one of the parts of a road for a single line of vehicles

ex.en: Leaves lay thick in the lane.
ex.zh: 小路上鋪滿了厚厚的落葉。

ex.en: They live on a quiet lane near the river.
ex.zh: 他們住在河邊一條安靜的小巷裡。

lane.en: a narrow road, especially in the countryside

ex.en: I'm going to mow the lawn tomorrow, weather permitting.
ex.zh: 如果天氣允許，我明天要去割草坪。

ex.en: Mother told me to mow the lawn.
ex.zh: 媽媽叫我去割草坪。

ex.en: The kids are playing on the lawn.
ex.zh: 孩子們在草地上玩。

lawn.en: an area of short, cut grass near a house

layout.zh: 版面設計；（空間）配置、格局

ex.en: I've changed my website's layout.
ex.zh: 我改了網站的版面設計。

ex.en: I like the layout of this office.
ex.zh: 我喜歡這間辦公室的格局。

ex.en: The store's layout makes it easy to find things.
ex.zh: 這家店的動線規劃讓人很容易找到東西。

layout.en: the way things are arranged on a page or in a space

ex.en: The customer filed a lawsuit against the company.
ex.zh: 那位顧客對公司提起訴訟。

ex.en: The two firms settled the lawsuit out of court.
ex.zh: 兩家公司在庭外和解了這起訴訟。

lawsuit.en: a case in which a person or company asks a court to settle a dispute

ex.en: According to one study, Amazon's sales go down by 1% for every 100-millisecond lag in its loading times.
ex.zh: 有研究指出，網頁載入時間每延遲 100 毫秒，Amazon 的銷售額就下降 1%。

ex.en: There is a time lag between ordering and delivery.
ex.zh: 從下單到交貨之間有一段時間差。

ex.en: Actually, I still haven't gotten over my jet lag.
ex.zh: 其實我的時差還沒調過來。

ex.en: I feel exhausted because of jet lag.
ex.zh: 我因為時差覺得好累。

lag.en: the tired feeling after a long flight across different time zones

ex.en: We should read the newspaper so as not to lag behind the times.
ex.zh: 我們應該看報紙，才不會跟不上時代。

ex.en: Our sales are lagging behind our competitors.
ex.zh: 我們的銷售落後於競爭對手。

lag.en: to move or develop more slowly than others

ex.en: Laser printers are generally cheaper to maintain than inkjet printers.
ex.zh: 雷射印表機的維護成本通常比噴墨印表機低。

ex.en: This clinic is doing laser surgery.
ex.zh: 這家診所有在做雷射手術。

ex.en: The speaker used a laser pointer during the presentation.
ex.zh: 講者在簡報時使用雷射筆。

laser.en: a strong, narrow beam of light used for cutting, printing and other tasks

ex.en: The accusations are shocking: money laundering, tax evasion and obstruction of justice.
ex.zh: 這些指控令人震驚：洗錢、逃稅和妨礙司法。

ex.en: The bank was fined for helping clients launder money.
ex.zh: 這家銀行因協助客戶洗錢而被罰款。

launder.en: to hide the illegal source of money by passing it through legal businesses

ex.en: The hotel will launder your shirts overnight.
ex.zh: 飯店會連夜幫你把襯衫洗燙好。

ex.en: All bed sheets are laundered daily.
ex.zh: 所有床單每天都會清洗。

launder.en: to wash and iron clothes or sheets

ex.en: Hurry up, or you will miss the last train.
ex.zh: 再不快點，你就要錯過末班車了。

ex.en: This is your last chance.
ex.zh: 這是你最後的機會。

ex.en: I saw him last week.
ex.zh: 我上週見過他。

ex.en: Last year we opened a new office.
ex.zh: 去年我們開了一間新辦公室。

ex.en: The Second World War lasted from 1939 to 1945.
ex.zh: 第二次世界大戰從1939年持續到1945年。

ex.en: The United States' Civil War lasted four years.
ex.zh: 美國南北戰爭持續了四年。

last.en: to continue for a period of time

ex.en: We gained the top of Mt. Fuji at last.
ex.zh: 我們終於登上了富士山頂。

ex.en: At last, the package arrived.
ex.zh: 包裹終於到了。

last.en: finally, after a long time or much effort

ex.en: It seems to me that the train is late.
ex.zh: 我覺得火車好像誤點了。

ex.en: Sorry I'm late.
ex.zh: 抱歉，我遲到了。

late.en: after the expected or usual time

ex.en: We carried on the discussion till late at night.
ex.zh: 我們一直討論到深夜。

ex.en: I worked late last night.
ex.zh: 我昨晚工作到很晚。

late.en: near the end of the day or night, or after the usual time

ex.en: May I ask you to call me back later?
ex.zh: 可以請你晚一點再回電給我嗎？

ex.en: See you later.
ex.zh: 待會見。

ex.en: What is the theme of his latest novel?
ex.zh: 他最新那本小說的主題是什麼？

ex.en: Have you seen the latest version of the app?
ex.zh: 你看過這個 App 的最新版本了嗎？

ex.en: She must come home by 9 at latest.
ex.zh: 她最晚九點前必須回家。

ex.en: Please reply by Friday at the latest.
ex.zh: 請最晚在星期五前回覆。

late.en: not after the time that is named

ex.en: London is among the largest cities in the world.
ex.zh: 倫敦是世界上最大的城市之一。

ex.en: India is the seventh largest country in the world.
ex.zh: 印度是世界第七大的國家。

ex.en: The population of Japan is larger than that of Britain.
ex.zh: 日本的人口比英國多。

ex.en: His income is three times larger than mine.
ex.zh: 他的收入是我的三倍。

ex.en: A large number of people came to the event.
ex.zh: 很多人來參加這場活動。

ex.en: Most Swiss people can speak three or four languages.
ex.zh: 大多數瑞士人會說三、四種語言。

ex.en: There are more than 4000 languages in the world.
ex.zh: 世界上有超過四千種語言。

ex.en: Mastering a foreign language involves a lot of patience.
ex.zh: 學好外語需要很大的耐心。

language.en: the system of words that people use to speak and write

ex.en: Please don't use bad language at work.
ex.zh: 上班時請不要說髒話。

ex.en: Python is a popular programming language.
ex.zh: Python 是很受歡迎的程式語言。

language.en: the words someone uses, or a system of code for writing computer programs

ex.en: The plane is landing in Tan Son Nhat airport.
ex.zh: 飛機正降落在新山一機場。

ex.en: Our flight landed on time.
ex.zh: 我們的班機準時降落。

land.en: to come down from the air and reach the ground

ex.en: About one third of the earth's surface is land.
ex.zh: 地球表面約三分之一是陸地。

ex.en: The earth is made up of sea and land.
ex.zh: 地球是由海洋和陸地組成的。

land.en: the dry part of the earth that is not sea

ex.en: They bought some land to build a factory.
ex.zh: 他們買了一塊地蓋工廠。

ex.en: Land prices in Taipei are very high.
ex.zh: 台北的地價很高。

land.en: an area of ground that someone owns or uses

ex.en: She landed a job at a big tech company.
ex.zh: 她在一家大型科技公司找到工作。

ex.en: We finally landed the contract.
ex.zh: 我們終於拿到了這份合約。

land.en: to succeed in getting a job or deal

ex.en: Tom meant it as a joke, but nobody laughed.
ex.zh: 湯姆本來是開玩笑，但沒有人笑。

ex.en: I don't know whether to cry or to laugh.
ex.zh: 我真是哭笑不得。

ex.en: I like the way she laughs at my jokes.
ex.zh: 我喜歡她聽我講笑話時笑的樣子。

laugh.en: to make sounds with your voice that show you think something is funny

ex.en: I don't like the way you laugh at her.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡你嘲笑她的樣子。

ex.en: Don't laugh at other people's mistakes.
ex.zh: 不要嘲笑別人的錯誤。

laugh.en: to make fun of someone in an unkind way

ex.en: We had a good laugh about it.
ex.zh: 我們為這件事大笑了一場。

ex.en: Her laugh is very loud.
ex.zh: 她的笑聲很大。

laugh.en: the sound or act of showing that something is funny

ex.en: The firm went under due to lack of capital.
ex.zh: 公司因缺乏資金而倒閉。

ex.en: He failed in the examination for lack of preparation.
ex.zh: 他因準備不足而考試不及格。

lack.en: the state of not having enough of something

ex.en: He is doing very well considering he lacks experience.
ex.zh: 考慮到他缺乏經驗，他已經做得非常好了。

ex.en: The kitchen lacks a dishwasher.
ex.zh: 廚房裡缺一台洗碗機。

lack.en: to not have something, or not have enough of it

ex.en: After some hesitation, he laid the book on the desk.
ex.zh: 猶豫了一下之後，他把書放在桌上。

ex.en: She will lay the doll on her bed.
ex.zh: 她會把娃娃放在床上。

ex.en: Lay the map on the table so we can all see it.
ex.zh: 把地圖攤在桌上，讓大家都看得到。

lay.en: to put something down carefully in a flat position

ex.en: Many workers were laid off at that plant.
ex.zh: 那間工廠裁掉了很多工人。

ex.en: The company laid off 200 workers last year.
ex.zh: 這家公司去年裁員兩百人。

lay.en: to stop employing a worker because there is not enough work for them

ex.en: A beautiful lake lay just beyond the forest.
ex.zh: 森林後面有一座美麗的湖。

ex.en: A moldy loaf of bread lay on the table.
ex.zh: 桌上放著一條發霉的麵包。

lay.en: to rest flat or be in a place (past tense of lie)

ex.en: The hens lay eggs every morning.
ex.zh: 母雞每天早上下蛋。

ex.en: Workers are laying new cables under the street.
ex.zh: 工人正在街道下鋪設新電纜。

lay.en: to produce an egg, or to put something in place on a surface

ex.en: Jim was afraid of physical labor.
ex.zh: 吉姆害怕做粗活。

ex.en: I'm not fit for physical labor.
ex.zh: 我不適合做體力活。

ex.en: He is reaping the fruits of his labor.
ex.zh: 他正在享受自己努力的成果。

ex.en: Capital, land and labor are the three key factors of production.
ex.zh: 資本、土地和勞動力是三大生產要素。

ex.en: The company is facing a labor shortage.
ex.zh: 公司正面臨人力短缺。

labor.en: the workers of a country or company

ex.en: She went into labor early this morning.
ex.zh: 她今天清晨開始陣痛。

ex.en: Her labor lasted twelve hours.
ex.zh: 她的分娩過程持續了十二小時。

labor.en: the process of a woman giving birth to a baby

ex.en: The old lady climbed the stairs with difficulty.
ex.zh: 那位老太太吃力地爬上樓梯。

ex.en: He helped an old lady get up from her seat.
ex.zh: 他扶一位老太太從座位上站起來。

ex.en: This is the lady who wants to see you.
ex.zh: 這位就是想見你的女士。

lady.en: a polite word for a woman

ex.en: The ladies' room is on the third floor.
ex.zh: 女廁在三樓。

ex.en: Excuse me, where is the ladies' room?
ex.zh: 不好意思，請問女廁在哪裡？

ex.en: I know a good lawyer who can help you.
ex.zh: 我認識一位不錯的律師，他可以幫你。

ex.en: Both of my parents are lawyers.
ex.zh: 我的父母都是律師。

ex.en: He is reputed the best lawyer in this city.
ex.zh: 他被公認是這座城市最好的律師。

lawyer.en: a person whose job is to give legal advice and speak for people in court

ex.en: The taste of wine is largely dependent upon the weather.
ex.zh: 葡萄酒的味道很大程度取決於天氣。

ex.en: The audience was largely made up of very young children.
ex.zh: 觀眾大多是年幼的孩子。

ex.en: The project's success was largely due to teamwork.
ex.zh: 這個專案的成功主要歸功於團隊合作。

ex.en: I prefer Noh to Kabuki because I find the former to be more elegant than the latter.
ex.zh: 比起歌舞伎，我更喜歡能劇，因為我覺得前者比後者優雅。

ex.en: Of the two options, I prefer the latter.
ex.zh: 這兩個選項中，我比較喜歡後者。

latter.en: the second of two things that were just mentioned

ex.en: Sales improved in the latter half of the year.
ex.zh: 下半年銷售有所改善。

ex.en: The latter part of the movie was boring.
ex.zh: 電影的後半段很無聊。

latter.en: near the end of a period of time

ex.en: There are a lot of fish in that lake.
ex.zh: 那座湖裡有很多魚。

ex.en: There are many lakes in the area where you live.
ex.zh: 你住的地區有很多湖泊。

ex.en: The old church by the lake is very beautiful.
ex.zh: 湖邊那座老教堂非常漂亮。

lake.en: a large area of water with land all around it

ex.en: Afghanistan has different kinds of landscapes.
ex.zh: 阿富汗有各種不同的地形景觀。

ex.en: The landscape is unfamiliar to me.
ex.zh: 這片風景對我來說很陌生。

landscape.en: everything you can see in an area of land, like hills and fields

ex.en: The digital landscape is changing very quickly.
ex.zh: 數位領域的情勢變化得非常快。

ex.en: AI has changed the business landscape.
ex.zh: 人工智慧改變了商業格局。

landscape.en: the general situation in a particular area of activity

ex.en: They landscaped the garden last spring.
ex.zh: 他們去年春天把花園做了景觀美化。

ex.en: The hotel grounds are beautifully landscaped.
ex.zh: 飯店的庭園景觀設計得很漂亮。

landscape.en: to change a garden or area to make it look nicer

ex.en: A day without laughter is a day wasted.
ex.zh: 沒有笑聲的一天就是浪費的一天。

ex.en: Laughter is good for your health.
ex.zh: 笑對健康有益。

ex.en: His words set everybody roaring with laughter.
ex.zh: 他的話讓大家哄堂大笑。

ex.en: The deep layers of the ocean are still almost unexplored.
ex.zh: 海洋的深層幾乎仍未被探索。

ex.en: A thin layer of dust covered the desk.
ex.zh: 桌上覆蓋了一層薄薄的灰塵。

ex.en: Wear several layers when you go hiking in winter.
ex.zh: 冬天去爬山時要多穿幾層衣服。

layer.en: a flat amount of material that covers a surface or lies between others

ex.en: Gently layer gold eyeshadow on the eyelids.
ex.zh: 在眼皮上輕輕疊上一層金色眼影。

ex.en: Layer the cheese and tomatoes in the dish.
ex.zh: 把起司和番茄一層層鋪在盤子裡。

layer.en: to put one thing on top of another in several levels

ex.en: As far as I know he is not lazy.
ex.zh: 就我所知，他不懶。

ex.en: Tom isn't as lazy as you think he is.
ex.zh: 湯姆沒有你想的那麼懶。

ex.en: He's the laziest person I know.
ex.zh: 他是我認識最懶的人。

lazy.en: not willing to work or make an effort

ex.en: We spent a lazy Sunday at home.
ex.zh: 我們在家度過一個慵懶的星期天。

ex.en: I love lazy afternoons at the beach.
ex.zh: 我喜歡在海邊悠閒的午後。

lazy.en: relaxed and slow, with no hurry or effort

lateral.zh: 側面的、橫向的；平行的（調動）

ex.en: The bridge can resist lateral forces from strong winds.
ex.zh: 這座橋能承受強風帶來的側向力。

ex.en: She made a lateral move to another department.
ex.zh: 她平調到另一個部門。

ex.en: Lateral thinking helps solve problems creatively.
ex.zh: 水平思考有助於用創意解決問題。

lateral.en: at, from or toward the side, or moving to a similar level

ex.en: I like to eat lamb kebabs.
ex.zh: 我喜歡吃羊肉串。

ex.en: I like beef more than lamb.
ex.zh: 比起羊肉，我更喜歡牛肉。

ex.en: The restaurant is famous for its roast lamb.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳以烤羊肉聞名。

lamb.en: the meat of a young sheep

ex.en: We saw lambs playing on the farm.
ex.zh: 我們在農場看到小羊在玩耍。

ex.en: The lamb followed its mother everywhere.
ex.zh: 小羊到哪裡都跟著媽媽。

ex.en: Traffic was blocked by a landslide.
ex.zh: 交通因為山崩而中斷。

ex.en: Heavy rain caused a landslide near the village.
ex.zh: 豪雨在村莊附近引發土石流。

landslide.en: a fall of earth and rocks down a hill

ex.en: She won the election by a landslide.
ex.zh: 她在選舉中大獲全勝。

ex.en: It was a landslide victory for the opposition party.
ex.zh: 這是反對黨的壓倒性勝利。

landslide.en: a win in an election by a very large number of votes

laundry.zh: 要洗（或洗好）的衣服；洗衣服

ex.en: I have to do laundry while it's still sunny.
ex.zh: 趁還有太陽，我得去洗衣服。

ex.en: Where should I put my laundry?
ex.zh: 我要洗的衣服該放哪裡？

ex.en: I'm doing the laundry while the weather is good.
ex.zh: 我趁天氣好在洗衣服。

laundry.en: clothes that need washing or have just been washed, or the act of washing them

ex.en: There's a laundry on the first floor of the building.
ex.zh: 這棟大樓一樓有洗衣房。

ex.en: I take my shirts to the laundry every week.
ex.zh: 我每週把襯衫送去洗衣店。

laundry.en: a place where clothes are washed

ex.en: Villagers lamented the loss of their old school.
ex.zh: 村民們為失去老學校而悲嘆。

ex.en: Many people lament the decline of traditional crafts.
ex.zh: 許多人感嘆傳統工藝的沒落。

lament.en: to feel or show deep sadness about something

ex.en: The song is a lament for a lost love.
ex.zh: 這首歌是為逝去的愛情而唱的悲歌。

ex.en: Her lament echoed through the empty hall.
ex.zh: 她的哀嘆聲在空蕩蕩的大廳裡迴盪。

lament.en: a song or poem that expresses deep sadness

ex.en: The horse went lame after hurting its leg.
ex.zh: 那匹馬腿受傷後就跛了。

ex.en: He has been lame since the accident.
ex.zh: 自從那次意外後，他走路就一跛一跛的。

lame.en: unable to walk well because of an injured leg or foot

ex.en: The new Harry Potter movie is pretty lame.
ex.zh: 哈利波特的新電影很遜。

ex.en: Saying the dog ate your homework is a lame excuse.
ex.zh: 說狗吃了你的作業是個很爛的藉口。

lame.en: weak and not good enough to be convincing or impressive

ex.en: We should always act in obedience to the law.
ex.zh: 我們應該一直遵守法律。

ex.en: This law will deprive us of our basic rights.
ex.zh: 這條法律會剝奪我們的基本權利。

ex.en: We are equal in the eyes of the law.
ex.zh: 法律之前人人平等。

law.en: the rules made by a government that everyone must follow

ex.en: Even our brains are subject to the laws of physics.
ex.zh: 就連我們的大腦也遵循物理定律。

ex.en: Newton discovered the law of gravity.
ex.zh: 牛頓發現了萬有引力定律。

law.en: a rule of nature or science that is always true

ex.en: Tom picked up the jar and read the label.
ex.zh: 湯姆拿起罐子讀標籤。

ex.en: The contents of the box are listed on the label.
ex.zh: 箱子裡裝什麼都寫在標籤上。

label.en: a piece of paper or cloth on an object that gives information about it

label.zh: 貼標籤；把…歸類為（常有負面意味）

ex.en: He's always putting labels on people.
ex.zh: 他老是給別人亂貼標籤。

ex.en: Please label each box with its contents.
ex.zh: 請在每個箱子上標明裡面的東西。

label.en: to attach a tag to something, or to describe someone in a fixed, limiting way

ex.en: The landlord says he wants to raise the rent.
ex.zh: 房東說他想漲房租。

ex.en: Why hasn't the landlord come to collect rent this month?
ex.zh: 為什麼這個月房東還不來收房租？

ex.en: Why did my sixty-year-old landlord buy a trampoline?
ex.zh: 我六十歲的房東為什麼要買彈簧床？

landlord.en: a person who owns a house or room and gets rent from people living there

ex.en: The company announced 500 layoffs.
ex.zh: 公司宣布裁員 500 人。

ex.en: Many workers lost their jobs in the layoffs.
ex.zh: 很多工人在這波裁員中失業。

layoff.en: the act of ending the work of a worker because there is not enough work

ex.en: My uncle's company launched a new product last month.
ex.zh: 我舅舅的公司上個月推出了一款新產品。

ex.en: Recently, this brand launched a series of limited edition underwear.
ex.zh: 最近這個品牌推出了一系列限量版內衣。

ex.en: Build your own championship team in a new football management simulation game, launching in early November.
ex.zh: 全新足球經理模擬遊戲將於 11 月初推出，邀你打造屬於自己的冠軍球隊。

launch.en: to start selling a new product or start a new activity

ex.en: They are going to launch an artificial satellite tomorrow.
ex.zh: 他們明天要發射一顆人造衛星。

ex.en: A satellite was launched in Russia last year.
ex.zh: 去年俄羅斯發射了一顆衛星。

launch.en: to send a rocket or missile into the air

ex.en: The launch was successful. We're now leaving the solar system.
ex.zh: 發射成功。我們正在離開太陽系。

ex.en: The product launch is scheduled for May.
ex.zh: 產品預計五月上市。

launch.en: the sending of a rocket into space, or the start of selling a new product

ex.en: The labor union negotiated a new pay agreement.
ex.zh: 工會協商了一份新的薪資協議。

ex.en: Employees may contact the labor union for support.
ex.zh: 員工可以聯絡工會尋求協助。

labor union.en: an organization of workers that protects their rights and pay

ex.en: High latency made the online meeting difficult.
ex.zh: 延遲過高讓線上會議很不順暢。

ex.en: The new server reduced network latency.
ex.zh: 新伺服器降低了網路延遲。

latency.en: the delay before something starts to happen, especially in a network

ex.en: The laborers finished unloading the materials by noon.
ex.zh: 勞工們中午前就卸完了材料。

ex.en: Each laborer must wear a safety helmet on site.
ex.zh: 每位工地勞工都必須戴安全帽。

laborer.en: a person who does hard physical work for pay

ex.en: Your coverage may lapse if the premium remains unpaid.
ex.zh: 如果保費一直未繳，保障可能會失效。

ex.en: The offer will lapse at the end of the month.
ex.zh: 這項優惠將於月底失效。

lapse.en: to end because the time limit has passed or nothing was done

ex.en: The landowner agreed to lease the field to a solar company.
ex.zh: 地主同意將這塊土地出租給太陽能公司。

ex.en: Local landowners attended the planning meeting.
ex.zh: 當地土地所有人出席了規劃會議。

landowner.en: a person who owns a large amount of ground

ex.en: The customer used layaway to pay for the bicycle over three months.
ex.zh: 顧客使用分期預購，分三個月付清腳踏車款項。

ex.en: Under the layaway plan, the store holds the item until it is paid off.
ex.zh: 採用留貨待付清方案時，商店會保留商品直到款項付清。

layaway.en: a way of buying in which the shop keeps an item until it is fully paid for

ex.en: The hosts prepared a lavish buffet for the visiting delegation.
ex.zh: 主辦方為來訪代表團準備了豐盛的自助餐。

ex.en: The resort is known for its lavish rooms and attentive service.
ex.zh: 這間度假村以豪華客房和周到服務聞名。

lavish.en: very rich and expensive, with more than is needed

ex.en: We had a three-hour layover in Singapore.
ex.zh: 我們在新加坡轉機停留了三個小時。

ex.en: If your layover is long enough, you can leave the airport and explore the city.
ex.zh: 如果轉機時間夠長，你可以出機場逛逛這座城市。

layover.en: a short stop during a long trip, especially between flights

ex.en: A historical landmark has been restored and will reopen.
ex.zh: 一座歷史地標已經修復並將重新開放。

ex.en: The tower is a famous landmark in the city.
ex.zh: 那座塔是這座城市著名的地標。

landmark.en: a building or place that is easy to see and recognize

ex.en: The agreement was a landmark in the country's history.
ex.zh: 這項協議是該國歷史上的里程碑。

ex.en: The court made a landmark decision on the case.
ex.zh: 法院對此案做出了具有里程碑意義的判決。

landmark.en: an event that is an important step in history

ex.en: The man is using the landline to call.
ex.zh: 那個男人正在用市內電話打電話。

ex.en: Few young people have a landline these days.
ex.zh: 現在很少年輕人有市內電話。

landline.en: a telephone that uses wires rather than a mobile network

ex.en: I will call you later this evening.
ex.zh: 我今天晚上晚一點再打給你。

ex.en: She arrived ten minutes later than the others.
ex.zh: 她比其他人晚了十分鐘到。

ex.en: See you later!
ex.zh: 待會見！

ex.en: The work needs a lot of hard labour.
ex.zh: 這份工作需要大量的粗重勞動。

ex.en: The factory is short of labour this year.
ex.zh: 這間工廠今年缺乏勞動力。

ex.en: He laboured all night to finish the report.
ex.zh: 他整晚辛苦工作，只為完成報告。

ex.en: They laboured in the fields from morning to dark.
ex.zh: 他們從早到晚在田裡辛勤勞動。

ex.en: The lad helped the old woman carry her bags.
ex.zh: 那個小伙子幫老奶奶提袋子。

ex.en: He was a quiet lad who loved books.
ex.zh: 他是個愛看書的安靜少年。

ex.en: The cat fell asleep on my lap.
ex.zh: 貓在我的腿上睡著了。

ex.en: She put the book in her lap and began to read.
ex.zh: 她把書放在膝上開始閱讀。

ex.en: He ran ten laps around the track.
ex.zh: 他繞著跑道跑了十圈。

ex.en: The swimmer was ahead by half a lap.
ex.zh: 那位游泳選手領先了半圈。

ex.en: The puppy lapped up the milk in seconds.
ex.zh: 小狗幾秒內就把牛奶舔光了。

ex.en: Small waves lapped against the side of the boat.
ex.zh: 小浪輕輕拍打著船身。

ex.en: The plane made a smooth landing despite the strong wind.
ex.zh: 儘管風很強，飛機仍平穩降落。

ex.en: Please stay seated until the landing is complete.
ex.zh: 降落完成前請留在座位上。

ex.en: There is a small window on the landing between the floors.
ex.zh: 樓層之間的樓梯平台有一扇小窗。

ex.en: She waited for me on the landing at the top of the stairs.
ex.zh: 她在樓梯頂端的平台等我。

ex.en: The landing of the boats took place at dawn.
ex.zh: 船隻在黎明時登陸。

ex.en: The astronauts celebrated the successful moon landing.
ex.zh: 太空人慶祝登月成功。

ex.en: The lawmaker explained the new rule to reporters.
ex.zh: 那位立法委員向記者說明了新規定。

ex.en: Lawmakers debated the budget for two days.
ex.zh: 立法委員們為預算辯論了兩天。

ex.en: Her wedding dress was decorated with fine white lace.
ex.zh: 她的婚紗用精緻的白色蕾絲裝飾。

ex.en: The curtains have a beautiful lace edge.
ex.zh: 這些窗簾有漂亮的蕾絲邊。

ex.en: Wait a second, my lace has come undone.
ex.zh: 等一下，我的鞋帶鬆開了。

ex.en: He bent down to tie his shoe laces.
ex.zh: 他彎下腰繫鞋帶。

ex.en: Lace your shoes tightly before you start running.
ex.zh: 開始跑步前，要把鞋帶綁緊。

ex.en: She laced up her boots and went out into the snow.
ex.zh: 她繫好靴子的鞋帶，走進雪地裡。

ex.en: Many scientific words come from Latin.
ex.zh: 許多科學用語來自拉丁語。

ex.en: He studied Latin in school and enjoys old books.
ex.zh: 他在學校學過拉丁語，也喜歡古書。

ex.en: The doctor wrote the Latin name of the plant on the label.
ex.zh: 醫生把那種植物的拉丁學名寫在標籤上。

ex.en: She loves Latin music and dances salsa every weekend.
ex.zh: 她喜歡拉丁音樂，每個週末都跳騷莎舞。

ex.en: Laura sings in a choir on Thursday evenings.
ex.zh: 蘿拉每週四晚上都在合唱團唱歌。

ex.en: Please send the file to Laura before noon.
ex.zh: 請在中午前把檔案寄給蘿拉。

ex.en: She hummed la la la while she washed the dishes.
ex.zh: 她邊洗碗邊哼著啦啦啦。

ex.en: The kids sang "la, la, la" because they forgot the words.
ex.zh: 孩子們因為忘了歌詞，就唱起了「啦、啦、啦」。

ex.en: Lawrence rides his bicycle to the office.
ex.zh: 勞倫斯騎腳踏車去辦公室。

ex.en: Please give this letter to Lawrence.
ex.zh: 請把這封信交給勞倫斯。

ex.en: Lancashire is a county in the north of England.
ex.zh: 蘭開夏郡是英格蘭北部的一個郡。

ex.en: Blackpool is a seaside town in Lancashire.
ex.zh: 黑潭是蘭開夏郡的一個海濱小鎮。

latino.zh: 拉丁裔男性、拉丁美洲裔的人

ex.en: He is a Latino who grew up in Texas.
ex.zh: 他是在德州長大的拉丁裔。

ex.en: The Latino community held a food festival downtown.
ex.zh: 拉丁裔社群在市中心舉辦了美食節。

lancaster.zh: 蘭開斯特（英格蘭西北部的城市）

ex.en: Lancaster is a historic city in the north-west of England.
ex.zh: 蘭開斯特是英格蘭西北部的一座歷史名城。

ex.en: There is a university in Lancaster that many students attend.
ex.zh: 蘭開斯特有一所許多學生就讀的大學。

ex.en: The labourer carried bricks all day under the hot sun.
ex.zh: 那名工人在大太陽下整天搬磚頭。

ex.en: Many labourers were hired to build the new bridge.
ex.zh: 許多工人受雇來建造那座新橋。

ex.en: They built a lasting friendship during university.
ex.zh: 他們在大學期間建立了長久的友誼。

ex.en: The festival made a lasting impression on me.
ex.zh: 這個節慶給我留下了持久的印象。

ex.en: We hope for a lasting peace in the region.
ex.zh: 我們希望這個地區能有長久的和平。

ex.en: Most of our household waste ends up in a landfill.
ex.zh: 我們家裡大部分的垃圾最後都進了垃圾掩埋場。

ex.en: Recycling more can reduce the amount of trash sent to landfill.
ex.zh: 多做回收可以減少送往掩埋場的垃圾量。

ex.en: Excuse me, where is the lavatory?
ex.zh: 不好意思，請問洗手間在哪裡？

ex.en: The train lavatory was clean and well stocked.
ex.zh: 火車上的廁所既乾淨又備品齊全。

ex.en: The virus can stay latent in the body for many years.
ex.zh: 這種病毒可能在體內潛伏多年。

ex.en: He has latent talent that he has never really used.
ex.zh: 他有從未真正發揮過的潛在才能。

ex.en: A butterfly larva is called a caterpillar.
ex.zh: 蝴蝶的幼蟲叫做毛毛蟲。

ex.en: The larvae hatched from the eggs within a week.
ex.zh: 幼蟲在一週內從卵中孵化出來。

ex.en: Taipei lies at about twenty-five degrees north latitude.
ex.zh: 台北位於北緯約二十五度。

ex.en: Ships use latitude and longitude to find their position at sea.
ex.zh: 船隻利用緯度和經度來確定海上的位置。

ex.en: The manager gave her a lot of latitude in how she did the project.
ex.zh: 經理讓她在執行專案的方式上有很大的自由度。

ex.en: Teachers have some latitude to choose their own materials.
ex.zh: 老師在選擇教材上有一些彈性空間。

ex.en: He ordered a cold glass of lager.
ex.zh: 他點了一杯冰涼的拉格啤酒。

ex.en: Lager is usually lighter in color than ale.
ex.zh: 拉格啤酒的顏色通常比艾爾啤酒淡。

ex.en: The garden smelled of fresh lavender after the rain.
ex.zh: 下過雨後，花園裡飄著新鮮薰衣草的香氣。

ex.en: She put a small bag of dried lavender in her drawer.
ex.zh: 她在抽屜裡放了一小包乾燥的薰衣草。

ex.en: She wore a lavender dress to her cousin's wedding.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件淡紫色的洋裝去參加表姊的婚禮。

ex.en: The walls of the baby's room were painted a soft lavender color.
ex.zh: 嬰兒房的牆壁漆成柔和的淡紫色。

ex.en: Hot lava flowed slowly down the side of the volcano.
ex.zh: 熾熱的熔岩順著火山的山坡緩緩流下。

ex.en: The lava cooled and turned into black rock.
ex.zh: 熔岩冷卻後變成黑色的岩石。

ex.en: Children carried paper lanterns through the streets at the festival.
ex.zh: 節慶時孩子們提著紙燈籠走過街道。

ex.en: He lit the lantern and walked into the dark cave.
ex.zh: 他點亮提燈，走進黑暗的山洞。

ex.en: She put mascara on her lashes.
ex.zh: 她在睫毛上刷了睫毛膏。

ex.en: A tiny hair fell onto his lash.
ex.zh: 一根細小的毛髮掉在他的睫毛上。

ex.en: Heavy rain lashed the windows all night.
ex.zh: 大雨整晚猛烈拍打著窗戶。

ex.en: The waves lashed against the rocks.
ex.zh: 海浪猛烈拍打著岩石。

ex.en: The sailors lashed the boxes to the deck.
ex.zh: 水手們把箱子牢牢綁在甲板上。

ex.en: He lashed the wood together with strong rope.
ex.zh: 他用結實的繩子把木頭捆在一起。

ex.en: The police made a lawful arrest.
ex.zh: 警方進行了合法的逮捕。

ex.en: It is lawful to park here on weekends.
ex.zh: 週末在這裡停車是合法的。

ex.en: They are lawful citizens who pay their taxes.
ex.zh: 他們是依法納稅的守法公民。

ex.en: The old fisherman called the young waitress a bonny lass.
ex.zh: 老漁夫稱那位年輕女服務生是個漂亮的姑娘。

ex.en: A cheerful lass served us tea at the village inn.
ex.zh: 一位開朗的姑娘在村裡的小旅店為我們端茶。

ex.en: Lastly, I would like to thank everyone for coming.
ex.zh: 最後，我要感謝大家的蒞臨。

ex.en: First wash the rice, then cook it, and lastly add the sauce.
ex.zh: 先洗米，再煮熟，最後淋上醬汁。

landed.zh: 降落、著陸（land 的過去式）

ex.en: The plane landed safely despite the storm.
ex.zh: 儘管有暴風雨，飛機仍安全降落。

ex.en: A small bird landed on the window sill.
ex.zh: 一隻小鳥停在窗台上。

ex.en: She landed a job at a design firm last week.
ex.zh: 她上星期在一家設計公司找到了工作。

ex.en: He finally landed the big contract.
ex.zh: 他終於拿下了那筆大合約。

ex.en: The landed gentry once held most of the countryside.
ex.zh: 擁有土地的仕紳階級曾掌控大部分鄉間。

ex.en: He came from a wealthy, landed family.
ex.zh: 他出身富有的地主家庭。

ex.en: Calm water filled the lagoon inside the coral reef.
ex.zh: 平靜的海水充滿珊瑚礁內的潟湖。

ex.en: We swam in a blue lagoon on the island.
ex.zh: 我們在島上一處藍色潟湖裡游泳。

ex.en: Our landlady lives downstairs and often brings us fruit.
ex.zh: 我們的女房東住在樓下，常常送水果給我們。

ex.en: The landlady raised the rent by ten percent this year.
ex.zh: 女房東今年把房租調漲了一成。

ex.en: Clear labelling helps people avoid food they are allergic to.
ex.zh: 清楚的標示能幫助人們避開會過敏的食物。

ex.en: The labelling of the boxes took all morning.
ex.zh: 幫這些箱子貼標籤花了一整個早上。

labelling.zh: 貼標籤；標明（label 的現在分詞）

ex.en: She is labelling the jars with the date.
ex.zh: 她正在把日期標在罐子上。

ex.en: Stop labelling people before you know them.
ex.zh: 在還不了解別人之前，別急著給人貼標籤。

ex.en: Vines climbed up the wooden lattice beside the door.
ex.zh: 藤蔓爬上門邊的木格子架。

ex.en: The pie was covered with a lattice of pastry strips.
ex.zh: 派的上面覆蓋著一層用酥皮條編成的格子。

ex.en: The donkey was laden with sacks of grain.
ex.zh: 那頭驢子馱著沉重的穀物袋。

ex.en: She came home laden with shopping bags.
ex.zh: 她提著大包小包的購物袋回到家。

ex.en: The knight held a long lance in his right hand.
ex.zh: 騎士右手握著一支長矛。

ex.en: The museum displays a lance from the Middle Ages.
ex.zh: 博物館展示著一支中世紀的長矛。

ex.en: The doctor lanced the infected spot to let the pus out.
ex.zh: 醫生切開感染處讓膿流出來。

ex.en: He lanced the blister with a sterile needle.
ex.zh: 他用消毒過的針刺破水泡。

ex.en: The garden has a labyrinth made of tall hedges.
ex.zh: 這座花園有一座用高大樹籬做成的迷宮。

ex.en: We got lost in the labyrinth of narrow streets.
ex.zh: 我們在狹窄巷弄組成的迷宮裡迷了路。

ex.en: The tax rules are a labyrinth of exceptions.
ex.zh: 稅務規定是一堆錯綜複雜的例外。

ex.en: She tried to find her way through the labyrinth of forms.
ex.zh: 她試著在繁雜的表格中摸索出路。

ex.en: The doctor explained the illness in terms a layman could understand.
ex.zh: 醫生用外行人聽得懂的話解釋這種疾病。

ex.en: To a layman, the machine looks very complicated.
ex.zh: 對門外漢來說，這台機器看起來很複雜。

languish.zh: 困在不好的處境中；衰弱

ex.en: Many files languish on his desk for months.
ex.zh: 許多文件在他桌上擱了好幾個月。

ex.en: The plant began to languish without enough sunlight.
ex.zh: 缺少陽光，這株植物開始萎靡。

ex.en: He lifted the latch and opened the gate.
ex.zh: 他拉起門閂，把門打開。

ex.en: The door latch is broken, so it won't stay shut.
ex.zh: 門閂壞了，所以門關不住。

ex.en: Please latch the gate so the dog can't get out.
ex.zh: 請把門閂上，這樣狗才不會跑出去。
